notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 1.4 Changelog
notes.notes:
Changelog
- 4 Hscene (Bath/Kitchen-Goblin + Slime).
- New Battle-Fuck UI
- Improved Textbox UI
The UI change overall should improve the display and readability for everybody who had such an issue before.
- Game optimized for people with weaker PCs
This means everything will reset once you leave the area, so you don't need to wait until the next day.
With this change, the game performance should improve and give the players an easier resource collection time.
But of course this means extra danger since the monster girls will reset as well.
This change not only includes quests or dating variables but also most parts of the reset script were resource/girl-related.

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise Demo Release + Important News
notes.notes:
[b]Build Related News:[/b]
Hello everbody Some of you may have noticed that the game demo was removed. The reason for this is because I wanted to rework the old demo to be more up-to-date.
[b] What are the differences? [/b]
The game's latest version was used as a base for the demo.
The players were able to enjoy the full beach area, but the kitchen/bath-related events were removed and the cave area as well.
Everything else—bug fixes, UI-road effect, and other small extras that improved the gameplay—stayed.
The demo playtime should be around 1-2 hours long. ( depends on the person. )
[b]Other News:[/b]
The game and the Steam pages received a lot of updates these days.
Links were added—people can join my Discord server, follow me on Twitter, etc.
New Capsules
New Trailer, which shows the game updated state, giving a better view for people of what kind of game this is.
New Page Design - Kinks and character designs are listed.
[b]Bad News[/b]
I didn't want to change the game price originally, but a lot of bad things have happened since the start of the year; one of them is not having a tax treaty and some other reasons.
The pricing change is not going to be big, but I will keep it at a reasonable price for the playtime and contents.
[b]Good News [/b]
If everything goes well, I'm going to have a nice surprise in the next month for people. (Next Area Related)
Paid version game time goes between 2-5 hours but of course its depends on the person. (for people if they considering buying the game)

notes.title: My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise 0.8 Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/51d4e5fd4d53c8bff5ad6c581e96591b42e2fd22.png[/img]
New Area - Caves

Three New Monster Girl - Features
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/4089fe38f029a56364eda671991d9ccf08666e44.png[/img]
Goblin

She will do the housebuilding instead of you; if you pay her money, you only need to get the blueprint from the invited girl.

After she finishes, all you need to do is go back to the desired girl, and the naming process will begin.

You can also hire her for some "fun" time to share together if you are full of energy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/813fcd39a62d2c581d03e70a5a0f50a788c46988.png[/img]
Dullahan

She is offering marriage services and separation. which means if you get enough love points for a fee, you can marry the girl.

Once you are married, the girl during the night will always be near your bed, where you can lewd her, like when you visited her in the bedroom before.

The difference is the home delivery part. If you are bored with the girl, you can use separation; you only need to pay a fee for it, and you can remarry without any issue again with another girl.

same as Goblin, you can pay her for some lewd service as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/326c9a5c2db427968d18e9ff1dab1e6953d16442.png[/img]

Arachne

She is our minigame-focused girl, while she does not offer lewd services like the others. If you lose the minigame, then you are going to end up being drained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/3596d475ac1c8f054d3f7d540435eaa716ee592d.png[/img]

There are multiple maps for the minigame, but it works this way. On the map, you will find multiple portals. You need to find the correct one among the fake ones.

Now there is the challenge part. When you walk around, there is a chance that you will trigger a spider girl to summon. This is still the easy part.

But when you try to find the correct portal, after every fake portal activation, another spider girl will show up, which means the longer it takes you to find

The way out, the less chance you have because the spider girl will chase after you in order to get you. I would say it's a hard minigame, but if you are

not paying attention to where you are running, then you will most likely end up with a loss.

New HScenes

The new girls got 3 Hscenes with 2 variants, the same as the other girls before.

Major Improvements and Fixes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/58445b5e2b4898e9a2f45cc32a1c9881689d5461.png[/img]

With multiple times I tried to improve the battle hud a little further with multiple ideas to make sure it would work with old saves as well, but in the end, I succeeded.

From now on, you can see the girls battle relation score for invitation; the book is staying as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/1a3122dcb39565542d532076badaadd9e3389975.png[/img]

I tried the same way with the availability of interactions, but sadly, it did not work because of transparency issues, so I ended up making it a part of the

choices to display your love score.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813025/65f1c45f203474ebb05c018008ad0ffd21fb84fc.png[/img]

Map "roads" received a glowing effect to make it easier for some people to find the entry for navigation.

Probably between 5000-10000 Words of text

New Events for the Area Introduction

From now on, if you want to date, you need to invite the Kitsune girl to unlock it.

Tavern minigame updated.

Fast travel by Centaur is updated and improved.

You can use the boat to travel to the caves as well.
